map.HAS-BLED 评分 = 高血压（收缩压高于 160 mmHg，1 分）+ 肾: HAS-BLED = hypertension (SBP >160 mmHg, 1) + abnormal renal/liver (1 each) + stroke history (1) + bleeding history/anemia (1) + labile INR (1) + age >65 (1) + drugs/alcohol (1 each), max 9; 0-2 low bleeding risk, 3 medium (closer monitoring), >=4 high, correct controllable factors and shorten follow-up.
map.肾：透析/移植/血肌酐>200μmol/L；肝：慢性肝病/胆红素>2倍正常上限伴: Renal: dialysis/transplant/creatinine >200umol/L; Liver: chronic liver disease/bilirubin >2x ULN with transaminase >3x
map.积极纠正可逆因素，谨慎选择抗凝方案: Actively correct reversible factors, choose anticoagulation cautiously
map.提示：HAS-BLED≥3分提示出血高危，但并非抗凝禁忌。应积极纠正可逆因素（控: Note: HAS-BLED>=3 suggests high bleeding risk but is not a contraindication. Actively correct reversible factors (control BP, stop antiplatelet/NSAID, abstain from alcohol, stabilize INR). DOAC has lower intracranial bleeding than warfarin; high-risk patients may prefer it. For clinical reference only.

map.抗凝出血风险：≥3 分为高出血风险，需更频监测与纠正可逆因素，但不因此禁用抗凝（: Bleeding risk: >=3 is high, needs more frequent monitoring and reversible-factor correction, but does not forbid anticoagulation (AF stroke risk often higher).
map.监测与管理：高出血者优先选更可控方案、控血压、停抗血小板/NSAID、限酒，缩短: Monitoring and management: high-bleeding prefer more controllable plan, control BP, stop antiplatelet/NSAID, limit alcohol, shorten INR interval.
map.输入：男、72 岁、未控高血压、轻度 CKD、无卒中、有胃出血史、INR 波动、: Input: male, 72, uncontrolled hypertension, mild CKD, no stroke, prior GI bleeding, labile INR, occasional alcohol. Output: HAS-BLED 5 (high bleeding), management correct reversible factors (lower BP, stop antiplatelet, limit alcohol, stabilize INR), anticoagulation still recommended (high stroke risk), monitoring shorten INR follow-up. Note: high bleeding != stop anticoagulation, must weigh.
